alt: Two 10-K text filings and two XBRL company-facts files are scrubbed of emails and phone numbers, chunked, embedded with all-MiniLM-L6-v2 and tagged with labels such as RISK:CYBER and TOPIC:CLOUD, then loaded as rows into the Apache Doris table filing_chunks, which carries both a vector index on embedding and a full-text index on text; editing the Apple filing re-processes only its chunk, and the hybrid query "cloud computing and AI risk" fuses vector and keyword ranks so Microsoft's cloud-and-AI filing ranks first and Apple's second.
needs: Docker (for Apache Doris 4.0+, compose file included)

run.note: Write the sample filings and company facts to data/
Hybrid search: vector + keyword, fused with RRF
run.cmd: python search.py "cloud computing and AI risk"
